examples.text: Among the various fractions isolated was one presumed to contain only desoxyribosenucleic acid (DNA). raw_glosses: (biochemistry, genetics) Initialism of deoxyribonucleic acid (“a nucleic acid found in all living things (and some non-living things such as certain viruses) which consists of two polynucleotide chains that coil around each other to form a double helix; encoded in its structure are genetic instructions for development, functioning, growth, and reproduction”).
